title: Only 70 Right Whale Mothers Hold Up The Recovery
hook: The whale comeback depends on a group smaller than a packed bus.
closing: Protecting each mother is the clearest way to keep this fragile recovery moving.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: The right whale population reached 384. The rebound exists, but every animal still matters.
The latest season produced 22 calves. New births are finally adding momentum to the rebound.
Only 70 are breeding females. Losing a few mothers could erase the progress those calves represent.
